articles.headline: Form SCHEDULE 13G SUNation Energy, Inc. Filed by: AWM Investment Company, Inc.
articles.summary: AWM disclosed beneficial ownership of approximately 19.9% of SUNation for its advised fund. The filing reports an ownership position; it does not establish a takeover bid, a fresh issuer financing or a causal explanation for later trading.
